column.title: Track a column
column.statement: Denominator reduction and final signed-permutation normalization are separate passes.

lde.title: Least denominator exponent
lde.statement: The least k with 2^k v integral is recorded for the active column.

parity.title: Odd entries form quartets
parity.statement: At positive k, the integral lift of a unit column has squared norm 4^k; its number of odd entries is divisible by four.

signs.title: Normalize odd residues
signs.statement: An odd integer is 1 or 3 modulo four. Negating a residue-three entry makes it residue one.

mixing.title: Four-row Hadamard action
mixing.statement: Applying H tensor H to four integers congruent to one modulo four produces even integers on those rows.

integral.title: Integral unit column
integral.statement: An integral unit column has one nonzero entry, equal to plus or minus one. A row swap and optional sign change put it in its target position.

completion.title: Fixed basis column
completion.statement: A completed column equals its corresponding positive basis vector and is preserved by subsequent operations.

verification.title: Exact equality
verification.statement: Orthogonality, reduction, and reconstruction are checked with exact rational entries.

recovery.title: Recover the input
recovery.statement: Chronological left reductions g1,...,gm give U=g1^-1...gm^-1. The circuit executes these factors right to left.
